name: OpenAI-compatible API (ao's own client)
disclaimer: ao's own stdlib client, ao-api-review, run here against a stand-in of the chat-completions endpoint on this machine (tests/test_api_review.py); a provider's own answer is proven on a local candidate by the owner, whose key it is.

roles.reviewer: eligible: one completion over the review prompt, through a provider's HTTP API, with no tools
roles.architect: ineligible: it answers one question and keeps no session

send.note: The prompt carries the candidate's diff; the diff file is the same bytes, handed as every tool reviewer is handed them.

stdin.note: A prompt past what one argument carries is read from standard input: ao-api-review takes - for it.

options.trust_none_note: nothing to deny: the client has no tools, and the model reads the prompt it is sent and nothing else
options.model_note: <provider>/<model>: the provider a word review.api_providers names on this machine, with its base URL and the environment variable holding its key
options.effort_note: ao composes no effort for a tool

environment.note: The providers are read from the machine's own settings file: one named through AO_SETTINGS could send the review, and its key, elsewhere.
